policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Security policies, procedures, and guidelines with approval tracking. Foundation of NIS2 Art. 21(1).
policies.helpText: Create and manage your information security policies. Each policy follows a lifecycle: draft, review, approved, archived. Track version history and ensure all relevant staff acknowledge current policies. NIS2 requires documented policies for risk management, access control, encryption, and more.
policies.empty: No policies yet. Create your first policy document.
policies.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this policy?

fieldDescriptions.title: Name of the policy document (e.g., 'Information Security Policy', 'Access Control Policy').
fieldDescriptions.type: Select the policy type (e.g., policy, procedure, guideline, standard).
fieldDescriptions.version: Version number for this policy revision (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Increment on each approval cycle.
fieldDescriptions.content: Full text content of the policy. Include scope, objectives, responsibilities, and specific requirements.
fieldDescriptions.status: Current lifecycle status: Draft (in preparation), Approved (active and enforced), or Archived (superseded).
fieldDescriptions.effectiveFrom: Date when this policy version becomes active and enforceable.
fieldDescriptions.reviewDue: Date by which this policy must be reviewed and updated. NIS2 expects regular policy reviews.
